# =====================================================================
#  conflictMode.registry.yaml
#  UDI-Compliant Conflict Mode Registry
#  Defines universal, portable, schema-agnostic merge behaviors
# =====================================================================

version: 1.0.0
registryName: "ConfigMerge ConflictMode Registry"
udiCompliant: true

schema:
  requiredFields:
    - name
    - description
    - behavior
    - appliesTo
    - precedence
    - asciiIndicator
    - udiCompliant
  optionalFields:
    - colourKey
    - notes
    - examples

modes:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # 0. removeWins — legacy paired include/exclude resolver
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: removeWins
    description: >
      Legacy behavior where exclude* entries are removed from include*
      after layered merge. Maintained for backward compatibility.
    behavior: remove
    appliesTo: [array, scalar]
    precedence: normal
    asciiIndicator: "-"
    colourKey: "conflict.remove"
    udiCompliant: true

    notes: >
      This mode assumes paired include*/exclude* keys and applies
      include-side removal when both sides are present.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. unionWins — additive merge (UDI-compliant)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: unionWins
    description: >
      All layers contribute. Arrays are merged by union; scalars use the
      highest-precedence non-null value. No assumptions about remove or
      exclude semantics. Safe default for all schemas.
    behavior: union
    appliesTo: [array, scalar]
    precedence: normal
    asciiIndicator: "="
    colourKey: "conflict.union"     # optional, used only when colourKeyPath is enabled
    udiCompliant: true

    notes: >
      This mode is portable across all modules and schemas. It does not
      assume the existence of excludeType or remove semantics. Works for
      includeType-only and includeType/excludeType schemas.

    examples:
      - default: [a,b]
        config: [b,c]
        mode: [d]
        final: [a,b,c,d]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. includeWins — full replacement (UDI-compliant)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: includeWins
    description: >
      Higher-precedence arrays or scalars replace lower-precedence values.
      No assumptions about remove or exclude semantics. Works for both
      includeType-only and includeType/excludeType schemas.
    behavior: replace
    appliesTo: [array, scalar]
    precedence: override
    asciiIndicator: "+"
    colourKey: "conflict.include"
    udiCompliant: true

    notes: >
      This mode is ideal for schemas where the higher layer should fully
      override lower layers. It does not require excludeType or remove
      semantics, making it universally portable.

    examples:
      - default: [a,b]
        config: [b,c]
        mode: [d]
        final: [d]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. cliWins — top-layer override (UDI-compliant)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: cliWins
    description: >
      CLI values override all other layers. Scalars and arrays are replaced
      entirely by CLI input. This mode is universal and does not assume any
      schema-specific semantics.
    behavior: override
    appliesTo: [array, scalar]
    precedence: top
    asciiIndicator: "!"
    colourKey: "conflict.cli"
    udiCompliant: true

    notes: >
      This mode is used for debugging, runtime overrides, audit-loop
      corrections, and user-driven configuration changes. It is always safe
      because CLI is the highest-precedence layer.

    examples:
      - default: [a,b]
        config: [b,c]
        cli: [x,y]
        final: [x,y]

# =====================================================================
# End of registry
# =====================================================================
